rationale: The agent applied a change to the order without first authenticating the user or confirming the action, both required by policy. There is no evidence of verifying the user’s identity or confirming that the order belonged to the requester before modifying it. The agent also failed to seek explicit confirmation before performing the order-changing write. While the agent reported a lower price and a refund (implying compliance with the “same or lower” requirement) and selected a non–water-resistant option, these do not offset the core policy violations. Therefore, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
